performance_gc_findings.title: Unbounded static ConcurrentHashMap cache memory leak in Item.ItemOption.OPTION_STRING

performance_gc_findings.impact: ItemTime.update() recalculates and sends full player stats multiple times in a single tick when multiple buffs expire simultaneously; Item.getInfo/getInfoItem concatenate Strings in loops.

performance_gc_findings.title: Redundant Service.point(player) recalculations in ItemTime.update() and String concatenation in Item.java

performance_gc_findings.title: Client.java synchronizes and mutates defensive copy from SessionManager.getSessions() every second

performance_gc_findings.title: Uncached blocking FileIO reads in DataGame.sendMapTemp/sendTileSetInfo and Thread.sleep polling in sendRes

performance_gc_findings.title: Synchronous disk I/O and global lock on Netty IO thread in PacketProfiler.triggerPerformanceAlert

performance_gc_findings.title: ServerManager.close() bypasses cleanupResources() player-save guard and double-invokes cleanup

performance_gc_findings.impact: Unnecessary heap allocations (Stream, String arrays, string concatenation) on hot combat loop paths.

performance_gc_findings.title: Per-attack Stream and per-target String[] allocations in SkillService hot paths

performance_gc_findings.impact: Unnecessary object allocations per bot tick, linear template scan per search request, uncached disk read on dashboard load, and stop-the-world pauses via System.gc().

performance_gc_findings.title: Minor GC/CPU inefficiencies in legacy Bot RNGs and AdminApiService handlers

performance_gc_findings.title: Unbounded playerTickMap leak in TrajectoryLogger and Message leak in Service.chatPrivate/sendPVB

performance_gc_findings.impact: Unnecessary object allocations and blocking I/O on caller threads.

performance_gc_findings.title: Clan.getPlayerOnline performs synchronous DB load for offline players

performance_gc_findings.title: Repeated Stream allocations in Satellite.update loop

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Multi-frame SmallImage sprites drawn from Big0-Big3 atlases render from texture origin (0, f*w) instead of their atlas coordinates smallImg[id][1..2], corrupting sprites.

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: SmallImage 9-arg drawSmallImage ignores atlas x0/y0 offsets in smallImg[id]

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Any non-iOS-AppStore caller of mSystem.getHeight(Image) receives image width instead of height; mSystem.arrayReplace silently leaves dest unmodified.

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: mSystem.getHeight returns width and arrayReplace is a silent no-op

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Double zoomLevel scaling in mGraphics.drawLine/fillTrans/fillArg and ignored alpha in fillRect

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: checkNumTicket() scans Char.myCharz().arrItemBag for idTicket and sets numTicket only if found, without resetting numTicket = 0 at the start of the method.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: CrackBallScr.checkNumTicket never resets numTicket to 0 when tickets are exhausted

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: NullReferenceException when rendering under-background effects whose EffectData was evicted by lastEff (>20 entries) or failed to load, crashing or failing the paint pass.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: paintUnderBackground calls getEffDataById(effId).img != null without checking if getEffDataById(effId) is null (unlike paint() at line 346).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Unchecked null dereference in Effect.paintUnderBackground

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: The `if (data != null)` block ends at line 480, but `if (t >= data.Length - 1)` at line 481 executes outside that null check.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Effect.update dereferences data.Length outside null check

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Throws ArgumentNullException when anim_data[num7] is null (if num7 != 0) or leaves anim_data[0] zero-initialized, breaking boss/effect animations with ID >= 201 that lack negative sentinel markers.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: When `!flag`, readData allocates `anim_data[0] = new short[num8]` on line 237, but copies into `anim_data[num7]` on line 238 instead of `anim_data[0]`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Array.Copy targets wrong slot anim_data[num7] instead of anim_data[0] in EffectData.readData

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: In saveKeySkillToRMS(), keySkill is sent using the exact same Service.changeOnKeyScr(array) call as saveonScreenSkillToRMS(); calling both in addSkillShortcut() causes the second call to overwrite the first or lose keySkill bindings.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: saveKeySkillToRMS() invokes Service.gI().changeOnKeyScr(array) instead of a keySkill-specific method/parameter, mirroring saveonScreenSkillToRMS().
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: saveKeySkillToRMS() calls changeOnKeyScr identical to saveonScreenSkillToRMS()

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Any VIP chat broadcast prefixed with '!' crashes chatVip() with ArgumentOutOfRangeException, preventing the message from being added to vChatVip.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: chatVip.Substring(1, chatVip.Length) passes chatVip.Length as the length parameter starting at index 1 in C# (startIndex + length > chatVip.Length).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Guaranteed ArgumentOutOfRangeException in chatVip() for '!' messages

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Selecting an alert line containing '@' either extracts an incorrect player name or throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: fnick = text2.Substring(num + 1, num2) passes an end index (num2 + num) as the length argument to C# string.Substring(startIndex, length).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Wrong Substring length argument in updateKeyAlert() causes out-of-range crash or bad nick parsing

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Horizontal scroll fling velocity is computed from stale pointer history on touch-down, causing erratic horizontal scrolling/flicks in ListNew.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: updatePos_LEFT_RIGHT initializes pointerDownLastX[0] inside the loop instead of pointerDownLastX[i] (unlike update_Pos_UP_DOWN at line 147).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Wrong array index in ListNew.updatePos_LEFT_RIGHT pointer history init

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: DivideByZeroException when maxPeas == 0, and IndexOutOfRangeException/NullReferenceException when isPeasEffect runs with currPeas <= 0 or null peaPostionX.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Line 146 divides by maxPeas without checking maxPeas > 0; line 174 indexes peaPostionX[currPeas - 1] without null or bounds checks on currPeas and peaPostionX.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Unchecked division by zero and array bounds in MagicTree.update

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Client NullReferenceException crash during mob death/knockback animation when hp reaches 0 without injureBy set or after startDie().
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: updateInjure() checks `(injureBy != null && injureThenDie) || hp == 0` then unconditionally accesses `injureBy.cdir`; updateMobWalk() checks `if (injureThenDie)` then unconditionally accesses `injureBy.cdir`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NullReferenceException on injureBy.cdir when mob dies with injureBy == null

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: DivideByZeroException crash in NewBoss.paint() if maxHp is 0; NullReferenceException in NewBoss.updateMobAttack() if charAttack/dameHP/frameArr is null or type < 1.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: NewBoss.paint() computes `(long)this.hp * 50L / (long)this.maxHp` without checking `maxHp <= 0`, and NewBoss.updateMobAttack() accesses `charAttack`, `dameHP`, `frameArr[type + 1]`, and `frameArr[15][type - 1]` without null/bounds checks (while `setAttack(Char)` at line 320 sets status=3 without initializing `charAttack` or `type`).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Missing zero/null/bounds guards in NewBoss.paint() and NewBoss.updateMobAttack()

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Boss position becomes framerate-dependent and snaps/drifts horizontally when moving vertically.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: NewBoss.paint() mutates `this.x` and `this.yTemp` directly inside the render method based on tile collisions and `y != yTemp`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NewBoss.paint() mutates world coordinates (x, yTemp) during rendering

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Infinite loop freezes client main thread if Res.random_Am_0(1) is ever called.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: random_Am_0(int a) only checks if (a <= 0) return 0, then loops while (num == 0) num = r.nextInt() % a. For a == 1, x % 1 is always 0.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Infinite loop in Res.random_Am_0 when a == 1

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Throws IndexOutOfRangeException when computing arrow frame for angles around 345 degrees.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: setFrameAngle clamps num with `if (num > 24) num = 24;` and indexes mpaintone_Arrow[num], whose length is 24 (valid indices 0..23).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Off-by-one array bounds clamp in Point.setFrameAngle

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Throws NullReferenceException in updateKeyTouchControl/doKeyText when focus_card or focus_card.cp is null, and DivideByZeroException in update() if max_amount == 0 or list.size() == 0, spamming Debug.LogError.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: RadarScr.update divides by focus_card.max_amount and list.size() without zero guards; updateKeyTouchControl and doKeyText dereference focus_card.cp.lim without null checks.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Missing zero-division and null guards in RadarScr

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when typing on keypad/multi-tap with password input mode active (keyInActiveState > 0 and caretPos > 0).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: passwordText.Substring(caretPos, passwordText.Length) passes total length instead of remaining length (passwordText.Length - caretPos) as the second argument.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: TField.setPasswordTest passes invalid length to Substring

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Pressing confirm (key 5) in non-touch ServerScr selects the wrong server (always row 0 column num) or throws when vecServer is empty.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: updateKey() invokes ((Command)vecServer.elementAt(num)).performAction() using column remainder num (mainSelect % n) instead of mainSelect.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: ServerScr.updateKey invokes command at column index num instead of mainSelect

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Out-of-bounds tileTypeAt queries evaluate as waterflow/waterfall/outside/down1pixel tiles; in paintOutTilemap (which does not clamp gssx..gssye to tmw/tmh), out-of-bounds cells match (type & 0x40) == 64, drawing stray water tiles and corrupting TileMap.yWater.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: tileTypeAt(x,y) and tileTypeAtPixel(px,py) catch Exception and return magic value 1000 (0x3E8 = 512|256|128|64|32|8), which sets bit flags T_WATERFLOW (64), T_WATERFALL (32), T_TOPFALL (128), T_OUTSIDE (256), T_DOWN1PIXEL (512), and T_RIGHT (8).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: TileMap.tileTypeAt returns bitmask-polluting magic value 1000 on out-of-bounds exception

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Any caller passing a custom IActionListener to Timer.setTimer never has its listener invoked; instead GameScr.gI().actionPerform is erroneously executed.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: setTimer assigns timeListener = actionListener, but update() ignores timeListener and hardcodes GameScr.gI().actionPerform(idAction, null); inside an empty try/catch.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Timer.update ignores stored timeListener and hardcodes GameScr.gI().actionPerform

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Throws DivideByZeroException in TransportScr.update() if TransportScr is updated while maxTime == 0.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Line 123 computes currSpeed = GameCanvas.w / 2 * time / maxTime without guarding maxTime <= 0.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Potential division by zero in TransportScr.update when maxTime is 0

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Clicking the right side of the screen where ListChars was previously drawn can unintentionally focus or teleport the player to stale coordinates even when ListChars is disabled.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: ListChars.Update() returns early when `!isShow` without clearing `listPlayers`, and ListChars.UpdateTouch() has no `if (!isShow) return;` guard, so it continues hit-testing stale `listPlayers` entries and calling `Utils.Teleport`/`Utils.FocusObject`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: ListChars.UpdateTouch processes clicks and teleports even when ListChars is hidden

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: If a player queues more than one item to auto-buy, buying the first batch wipes out all queued items; starting a new buy overwrites the active quantity.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Items.autoBuy() stores target quantity in a single shared `int quantity` field rather than inside `ItemGroup`, and clears the entire `itemBuys` list (`itemBuys.Clear()`) as soon as `quantity <= 0`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Items.autoBuy uses a single shared quantity counter across the entire itemBuys list

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Any invalid chat input like `k `, `k abc`, `cheat `, or non-numeric NPoint potential input crashes the client loop with unhandled exceptions; NPoint also cannot target stats above `int.MaxValue` despite using `long` fields (`hpg`, `mpg`, `dameg`).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `ClientManager.Chat` calls `float.Parse`/`int.Parse` on `text.Split(' ')[1]` without bounds or format checks; `NPoint.onChatFromMe` calls `int.Parse` without `TryParse` and does not reset `ChatTextField` on early returns (lines 179, 204).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Unhandled int.Parse/float.Parse and missing bounds checks in ClientManager.Chat and NPoint.onChatFromMe

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Client will spam `wakeUpFromDead()` packets indefinitely every 20 ticks while dead, bypassing the intended `maxReviveCount = 5` limit.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `Revive.reviveCount` is incremented and reset after 60s, but `Revive.maxReviveCount` is never checked in `PlayerRevive()`. Also `Char.myCharz()` is dereferenced without null check.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Revive.maxReviveCount is never enforced in PlayerRevive()

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: NullReferenceException when rendering consignment or shop rows containing a null Item slot, breaking `paintShop` and causing repeated console errors.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `paintShop` guards `if (item != null)` at line 4580, but after closing that block at line 4750, line 4751 unconditionally evaluates `item.buyType == 0` without checking `item == null`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NullReferenceException in paintShop when item slot is null

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Opening clan search or tapping while `clans` is null throws NullReferenceException; switching to `setTabClans` with fewer than 4 tabs throws IndexOutOfRangeException.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `getCurrClan()` reads `clans.Length` without checking `clans != null`; `setTabClans()` reads `lastSelect[3]` without bounds check; `setTabKiGui()` and `setTabShop()` read `Char.myCharz().arrItemShop[...].Length` without null/length checks.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Missing null and bounds checks in getCurrClan, setTabClans, setTabKiGui, and setTabShop

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Option 107 visual aura/frame effect renders the wrong tier or null whenever an item has any subsequent option with param != option 107's param.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `paintEff` checks `item.isHaveOption(107)` then loops over every `option` in `item.itemOption`, overwriting `img_frame` and `img_bg` based on `option.param` regardless of `option.optionTemplate.id`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: paintEff overwrites option 107 effect lists with unrelated item option params

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Clicking Back in the Change Flag menu unexpectedly disconnects the player from the game server.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: doFireChangeFlag() creates a Back Command with idAction=10031, but perform() handles idAction==10031 by calling Session_ME.gI().close().
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Change Flag Back button (idAction 10031) closes network session

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Non-numeric or overflowing consignment quantity input crashes with unhandled FormatException/OverflowException, and 0/negative quantities can be submitted to consignment flow.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: onChatFromMe parses currItem.quantilyToBuy via raw int.Parse without try/catch and only checks > currItem.quantity without checking <= 0 or currItem != null.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Unchecked int.Parse and missing <= 0 / null validation for consignment quantity in onChatFromMe

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Clicking empty slots or stale indices in new inventory, legacy bag/box, achievement, skill, or trade panels can throw NullReferenceException or IndexOutOfRangeException.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: doFireArchivement, doFireInventory, doFireGiaoDich, doFireShop, doFireBox, and doFireSkill index arrays/MyVectors or dereference currItem/text without null or bounds checks (and line 10337 checks text.Equals before text == null).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Missing null and array/vector bounds checks in doFire* handlers and onChatFromMe

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Corrupts ItemOption template/param in-place on first compare, and causes int overflow/wrong MP cost display in potential upgrade UI when defense > 21,469.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: getCompare() mutates item.itemOption[0].optionTemplate and param*=1000 in-place; doFireSkill() displays cHPGoc instead of cMPGoc for MP upgrade; cDefGoc*1000 and 500000+cDefGoc*100000 compute in 32-bit int before long assignment.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: In-place ItemOption mutation in getCompare, MP/HP typo in doFireSkill, and 32-bit int overflow in defense cost display

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: NullReferenceException when Char.myCharz().taskMaint is null and player selects Account option 4 on non-language-2 clients.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: doFireAccount() accesses Char.myCharz().taskMaint.taskId <= 10 without checking Char.myCharz().taskMaint != null (unlike PopUp.update()).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Missing null check on taskMaint in Panel.doFireAccount

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players killing SieuBoHung via its self-destruct mechanic never receive kill rewards, drops, or Boss task/quest completion credit.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: SieuBoHung.injured() triggers setBom(plAtt) instead of die(plAtt) when lethal damage is taken; 2500ms later Boss.handleBom() hardcodes `Player plAtt = null; die(plAtt);`, so Boss.die() skips `reward(plKill)` and ServerNotify.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: SieuBoHung self-destruct (handleBom) passes null killer, skipping reward and quest credit

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Clicking a boss in Máy Dò Boss (Boss Radar) teleports/selects the wrong boss or fails because indices do not match.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: showListBoss() filters `this.bosses` by `isBossTaskMain()` into `validBosses` and writes `validBosses` index `i` into Message(-96), while getBossByIndex(index) indexes the unfiltered `this.bosses` and `BrolyManager.gI().bosses` lists.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Index mismatch between showListBoss() and getBossByIndex() breaks Boss Radar selection

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: SieuBoHung immediately exits AFK back to ACTIVE before its 7 XENCON children finish spawning, fighting players simultaneously during the 6s spawn delay.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: callCellCon() sets bossStatus = BossStatus.AFK and schedules XENCON1-7 spawn 6000ms later, but autoLeaveMap() runs every update tick and forces `AFK -> ACTIVE` whenever `this.currentLevel > 0` (form 2).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: SieuBoHung.autoLeaveMap() prematurely cancels AFK state during callCellCon()

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Boss HP recovery and damage tracking overflow to negative values when damage > 2.68B (Android19) or > Integer.MAX_VALUE (XenBoHung, Broly, BlackGoku, etc.).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Android19 casts `(int) ((long) damage * 80 / 100)` before calling hoiPhuc; XenBoHung casts `maxDameAllowed`/`maxHpAllowed` to `(int)` when assigning `dameg`/`hpg`; 7 Boss subclasses cast `long` damage to `(int)` on `return` from `long injured(...)`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Integer truncation/overflow in Android19, XenBoHung, and Boss injured() returns

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Shielding does not reduce incoming damage on Halloween event bosses, making the shield skill completely ineffective.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Inside `if (!piercing && effectSkill.isShielding)`, all three Halloween bosses execute `damage = damage / 1;` instead of `damage = 1;`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Halloween bosses (BiMa, Doi, MaTroi) divide damage by 1 instead of setting damage to 1 when shielded

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Attacks exceeding Integer.MAX_VALUE (e.g., against uncapped bosses like Cumber, BuiBui, DrLychee, Hatchiyack) overflow when returned as int, causing negative or corrupted damage return values.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.location: TuanLoc.java:212, Cooler.java:115, DeathOrAliveArena.java:235, DrLychee.java:89, Hatchiyack.java:87, GoldenFrieza.java:86, BiMa.java:53, Doi.java:52, MaTroi.java:56, Cumber.java:80, LanCon.java:212, BuiBui.java:106
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Methods declare `public synchronized long injured(...)` and accept `long damage`, but explicitly cast `return (int) damage;`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: All active Boss injured() overrides truncate long damage to (int) on return

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: TuanLoc spawns under TET_EVENT and LanCon spawns under CHRISTMAS_EVENT, breaking event-type boss spawning/lifecycle; LanCon also skips zones containing ONG_GIA_NOEL instead of Tet bosses.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: TuanLoc (ChristmasEvent) passes `TET_EVENT` to super(), while LanCon (LunarNewYearEvent) passes `CHRISTMAS_EVENT` to super() and checks `BossID.ONG_GIA_NOEL` due to copy-paste.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: TuanLoc and LanCon have swapped BossType constants (TET_EVENT vs CHRISTMAS_EVENT)

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: If Manager.itemIds_tl_GN or itemIds_tl_AWJ has length <= 1, new Random().nextInt(length - 1) throws IllegalArgumentException; otherwise the last array item can never drop.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `new Random().nextInt(Manager.itemIds_tl_GN.length - 1)` passes `length - 1` to exclusive bound `nextInt(bound)`, and allocates a new `Random` on every kill.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Cumber.reward() off-by-one Random bound skips last item and throws if array length <= 1

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Drabura2 never dies through normal combat; players receive no fightMabu point reward, no item drops, and no boss-kill task completion.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: In Drabura2.injured(), `if (damage >= this.nPoint.hp)` sets status to BossStatus.AFK and resets `damage = 0` before `subHP(damage)`. Thus `isDie()` is never true, `die(plAtt)` / `reward(plAtt)` are bypassed, and `afk()` immediately switches to BossStatus.DIE.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Drabura2 resets lethal damage to 0 and skips die()/reward()

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Cadic dodges 100% of all non-piercing attacks whenever tlNeDon >= 1, making him nearly unkillable except by piercing skills.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `Util.isTrue(this.nPoint.tlNeDon, 1)` passes denominator `1` instead of `100` or `1000`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Cadic dodge roll uses denominator 1 instead of 100/1000

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Can throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException during boss reward() if LuongLong arrays are shorter than Kaio arrays, or IllegalArgumentException if any array length <= 1; also never drops the last array element.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Lines 247/250 (Cadic) and 248/251 (Goku) index `itemIds_LuongLong_AWJ[randomDo]` and `itemIds_LuongLong_GN[randomDo1]` using Kaio-bounded random indices instead of `randomDo2` and `randomDo3`, and `new Random().nextInt(len - 1)` excludes the final index.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Wrong array indices and off-by-one Random bound in Cadic.reward and Goku.reward

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Throws NullPointerException on non-player damage (e.g. burn/DoT/boss-vs-boss) or when fightMabu is null, interrupting damage application or reward logic.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `plAtt.isPl()` and `plAtt.fightMabu.changePercentPoint(...)` / `plKill.fightMabu.changePoint(...)` are called without null-checking `plAtt` or `fightMabu`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Missing null checks on plAtt and fightMabu in MajinBuu12H/14H bosses

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players can farm infinite item ID 590 drops on every single attack after depleting a Yardart's HP once, instead of once per full HP bar.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: In Yardart.injured(), when damage >= this.nPoint.hp, Service.gI().hsChar(this, hpMax, mpMax) restores HP, and line 253 immediately overwrites this.nPoint.hp = 1. Every subsequent hit has damage >= 1, failing (hp > damage) and triggering reward(plAtt) on every hit.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Yardart HP reset to 1 after hsChar allows reward drop on every hit

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Whis dies prematurely (often at ~50% HP) and, because hp remains > 0 while status becomes AFK, subsequent attacks during AFK re-trigger die(), repeatedly incrementing training top and spamming TraningDAO.updatePlayer() DB writes.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Whis.injured() subtracts damage at line 73 (this.nPoint.subHP(damage)), then checks if (damage >= this.nPoint.hp) at line 80 against the post-subtraction HP instead of isDie() (hp <= 0), and lacks an outer if (!this.isDie()) guard.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Whis dies prematurely and can trigger die() + DB update multiple times

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: The Pocolo tournament opponent spawns as JackyChun (wrong BossID, name, outfit, skills, and stats) in The 23rd Martial Art Congress.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Copy-paste constructor calls super(PHOBAN, BossID.JACKY_CHUN, BossesData.JACKY_CHUN) instead of BossID.POCOLO and BossesData.POCOLO.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Pocolo constructor uses BossID.JACKY_CHUN and BossesData.JACKY_CHUN

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Boss CADICH HP overflows int to a negative number when SnakeWay level >= 114 (e.g., level 114 computes 64*64*538888 = 2,207,285,248 > Integer.MAX_VALUE), and mob damage/HP calculations also use int arithmetic before assignment.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: `60000000 + (long)((level - 50) * (level - 50) * 538888)` multiplies three ints before casting to long, and mob dame/maxHp use `(int) level * 1000 * mob.tempId * 12`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Numeric int overflow in SnakeWay CADICH HP and mob stats scaling

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players who win Round 4 with at least 1 empty bag slot receive 2 Capsule Vangs instead of 1 (one in Whis mailbox and one directly in bag).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: onBossDie() unconditionally calls WhisArenaService.gI().addReward(player, 574) at line 339, and then at lines 344-349 also creates and adds ConstItem.CAPSULE_VANG directly to bag when getCountEmptyBag(player) > 0.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Double Capsule Vang reward on winning Whis Arena U6 Round 4

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: After a match ends via fallOut(), update() executes die() and leaveMap() in the same tick on nulled player fields, re-triggering finish()/dispose() and throwing NPEs (silently caught).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: fallOut() invokes finish() -> dispose() which nulls player_1, player_2, npc, and zone, yet update() immediately calls die() and leaveMap() afterward; leaveMap() treats player_2==null as forfeit and calls finish() again. Also init() calls npc.location without null check.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Double finish() invocation and NPEs in WorldMartialArtsTournament

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Validation can evaluate stale superRank data (rank, ticket) or loadData can overwrite current superRank state after checks pass.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: SuperRankDAO.loadData(player) is invoked at line 70 after rank comparisons and ticket/gem checks at lines 57-68.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: SuperRankDAO.loadData(player) called after rank and ticket validation checks

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: talkToThanMeo state is lost/corrupted on relog (overwritten with talkToThuongDe), and Whis training/luyentap updates saved via TraningDAO are discarded on next login.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: NDVSqlFetcher reads index 2 twice for both talkToThuongDe and talkToThanMeo instead of index 3; TraningDAO writes 10 elements to data_luyentap without updating data_training, which NDVSqlFetcher reads second and uses to overwrite player.traning.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: CDRD index copy-paste bug and TraningDAO vs data_training persistence mismatch on loadPlayer

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players lose gold, gems, and materials while receiving no output item when bag is full, or encounter NullPointerException crashes.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: These combine handlers call InventoryService.addItemBag BEFORE subtracting source items and without checking getCountEmptyBag(player) > 0. NangCapSachTuyetKi line 53 also dereferences sachTuyetKy.template.id before its null check.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Missing bag-space checks and item-add-before-remove causing item loss and NPE in multiple combine handlers

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players can re-strengthen an already-strengthened 8-star item if option 230 precedes option 107; ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/Vang misinterpret option 230 as downgrade penalty and corrupt/duplicate item options on conversion.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Option ID 230 has conflicting meanings across modules; CuongHoaLoSao overwrites checkOption=0 when option 107 appears after 230; ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/Vang copy all options from index 1..n of trangBiGoc onto trangBiCanChuyenHoa without filtering base stats or duplicate option IDs.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Conflicting option 230 semantics, option-order bug in CuongHoaLoSao, and option corruption in ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/Vang

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players can open Wood Chest (570) infinitely without waiting for midnight, lose items when bag is full, or crash on out-of-bounds param; players can craft Dragon Egg (1426) from 1 shard instead of 99.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: openWoodChest never updates pl.lastTimeRewardWoodChest = System.currentTimeMillis() and never checks getCountEmptyBag or itemOptions bounds. open1427 calls subQuantityItemsBag(pl, item, 99) without verifying item.quantity >= 99.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Infinite Wood Chest Exploit & 1-for-99 Item Craft Exploit in ChestBoxItemHandler

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players with a stack of Xinbato Water Bottles (456) lose up to 99 bottles on a single use; Radar cards with Max/maxLevel > 127 overflow byte maxPerLevel and grant max level for 0 cards.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: useBinhNuocXinbato checks item.quantity >= 1 then subtracts 99. useCardBatch casts maxPerLevel and card.Amount to signed byte (overflowing > 127 to negative).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Wrong Item Deduction (99 vs 1) in ConsumableItemHandler & Byte Overflow in SpecialItemHandler.useCardBatch

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: getRubyPrice fails to find Ruby-priced items (returns wrong Gem-priced items or -1); subMoneyByItemShopV2 displays negative deficit amounts to players.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: getRubyPrice (line 805) checks `is.typeSell == COST_GEM` (1) instead of `COST_RUBY` (3). subMoneyByItemShopV2 (lines 615, 619) computes `player.inventory.gold - gold` and `player.inventory.coupon - coupon` (negative values) instead of `cost - current`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Wrong currency constant in getRubyPrice and inverted deficit math in subMoneyByItemShopV2

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Integer overflow in sell confirmation dialog, IndexOutOfBoundsException on bad body/bag index, and blocked selling of permanent items when a timed item of the same ID is in bag (or vice versa).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: showConfirmSellItem uses `int cost` and `cost *= quantity` (lines 890-905), causing int overflow for high-value stacks; neither showConfirmSellItem nor sellItem checks upper bounds (`>= size()`) or negative index after `version < 220` adjustment (lines 879-882); sellItem line 952 checks `InventoryService.getParam(pl, 93, item.template.id) > 0` across bag instead of checking option 93 on the specific `item` being sold.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Int overflow, missing bounds checks, and wrong HSD check in sellItem/showConfirmSellItem

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Special skill update continues running after closeSkillSpecial() or races with close(), and cannot properly gate on isStartSkillSpecial == true.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Assignment operator used instead of equality comparison: `if (this.isStartSkillSpecial = true)`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NewSkill.update() uses assignment (=) instead of comparison (==) on isStartSkillSpecial

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: All callers of NPoint.calPercent receive 66.7% of the intended percentage value (e.g., 50% becomes 33.3%).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Both calPercent(long, int) and calPercent(int, int) divide by 150 instead of 100.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NPoint.calPercent() divides by 150 instead of 100

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Punch stack bonus (+1% per punch up to tlDamePunchMax) is wiped out on every stat recalculation (every ~150ms or equip/buff).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: resetPoint() sets `this.tlDamePunchMax = 0;` and immediately checks `if (this.tlDamePunchMax == 0) { this.stackDamePunch = 0; }`, which is always true.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NPoint.resetPoint() unconditionally resets stackDamePunch to 0

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Whenever a pet is to the left of its master (disX < 0), disX < 50 is always true, causing continuous teleportation and playerMove packet spam on every update tick.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: followMaster(int dis) compares signed `disX < 50` (where `disX = this.location.x - mX`) instead of `Math.abs(disX) < 50`.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Pet.followMaster() checks signed disX < 50, triggering infinite move/packet spam when pet is left of master

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Player retains training armor dame% buff permanently after selling, dropping, trading, or banking the item; also cannot switch to a different training armor while stale reference exists.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: setDameTrainArmor() caches an unequipped bag training armor in inventory.trainArmor when null and continues applying its dame bonus without verifying the item still exists in itemsBag.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NPoint.setDameTrainArmor() retains stale inventory.trainArmor reference after item leaves bag

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Throws ArithmeticException: / by zero if mpMax is 0 (e.g. during stat reset or before initial calPoint).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: getCurrPercentMP() divides by this.mpMax without checking `if (this.mpMax == 0)` (unlike getCurrPercentHP()).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: NPoint.getCurrPercentMP() lacks zero-division guard on mpMax

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: In ATTACK mode against mobs at range, pet fires skill 2 ignoring cooldown, master idle check (canAttack), and askPea() when out of mana.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Mob ranged skill-2 branch in Pet.update() omits canUseSkillWithCooldown(), canAttack(), and else askPea() present in the PROTECT branch.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Pet.update() ATTACK mode skips cooldown, canAttack, and askPea checks for ranged mob skill 2

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players wearing partial sets with an empty earlier slot (e.g. missing shirt slot 0) receive 0 set bonuses; items with SKT option + option 21 param 80 may skip setDHD counting.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: setupSKT (line 140-142) and setupSKHNew (line 180-182) execute `break` instead of `continue` when an equipment slot is null; setupSKT also breaks early on `isActSet` before checking remaining options on the same item.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: SetClothes.setupSKT/setupSKHNew break on empty slot instead of continue

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: When chibi type 0 is active, picking up/receiving gold via addItemBag credits 2x gold and can exceed getGoldLimit(); items 925-931 gain duplicate 2-day expiry options on every addItemList call.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: addGold is called twice when isChibi && typeChibi == 0 after checking limit only for 1x quantity; lines 852-854 unconditionally add Option(93, 2) without checking if option 93 is already present.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Double gold credit bypassing limit and duplicate expiry options in InventoryService.addItemBag/addItemList

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Casting Tri Thuong heals enemy/PvP players in 300px range and multiplies the caster's own HP/MP heal by the number of targets in the AoE.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: In useSkillBuffToPlayer (TRI_THUONG), line 857 checks canHsPlayer(player, plTarget) instead of canHsPlayer(player, pl) when filtering players in 300px radius, and lines 872-873 heal the caster player inside the for (Player pl : players) loop on every iteration.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Skill.TRI_THUONG heals enemies and multiplies caster self-heal per target

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players with >2.14B HP have their HP truncated to 2,147,483,647 on every Kaioken attack, and players with 1-10% HP cannot cast Kaioken despite only needing 1-3% HP.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: useSkillAttack wraps hpUse and remaining HP (hp - hpUse) in Util.maxIntValue() (line 440) clamping long HP down to Integer.MAX_VALUE; additionally, canUseSkillWithMana (line 1175) requires hp > 10% hpMax while useSkillAttack deducts 1-3% hpMax (and if hp <= hpUse at line 437 it breaks out of switch skipping affterUseSkill while still returning true).
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Kaioken truncates >2.14B HP to Integer.MAX_VALUE and mismatches mana check (10% vs 1-3%)

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Neutral players in public maps (cFlag == 0) get buffed by another player's Huyt Sao, and neutral Namec players lose 10% HP unconditionally without PvP/flag/death checks.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: useSkillAlone (HUYT_SAO) filters zone.getHumanoids() using only player.cFlag == pl.cFlag without checking cFlag != 0 or canAttackPlayer/isDie, applying Huyt Sao buff or 10% hpMax damage (to Namec) to all neutral players in the zone.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Skill.HUYT_SAO affects neutral (cFlag == 0) players and damages neutral Namecs in safe/public maps

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Expired giftcodes remain redeemable indefinitely; empty listGiftCode crashes info tutorial with StringIndexOutOfBoundsException; case-mismatched codes fail lookup.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: checkUseGiftCode() never validates giftCode.dateexpired, creates case-sensitive equals() against lowercased DB inserts, checkInfomationGiftCode() calls sb.deleteCharAt(sb.length() - 1) when empty without synchronization, and reload() invokes rs.getBoolean("allGender") for non-"all" strings.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: GiftCodeManager skips expiration check and has unsynchronized iteration/empty crash

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players opening Nguoi Tuyet Bang Gia have a 25.6% chance of receiving no reward at all.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Independent sequential rolls (`if (isTrue(20,100)) ... else if (isTrue(20,100)) ... else if (isTrue(60,100))`) yield 0.2 + 0.16 + 0.384 = 74.4% total probability instead of 100%.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: 25.6% no-reward bug in RewardService.rewardNguoiTuyetBangGia()

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Server thread hang (100% CPU infinite loop) if the randomly picked mapId (0..20) has no zone or only zoneId == 0.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: mapId is selected once before the while(zoneJoin == null || zoneJoin.zoneId == 0) loop; getMapWithRandZone(mapId) is retried on the same mapId forever without a retry cap or re-rolling mapId.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Potential infinite loop in Util.randomAllMap

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Dead mobs spam -124 network messages to all players in the zone on every game tick until they respawn.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Operator precedence bug in `if (isBlindDCTT && (Util.canDoWithTime(lastTimeBlindDCTT, timeBlindDCTT)) || mob.isDie())` causes `mob.isDie()` alone to trigger `removeBlindDCTT()` every update tick even when `isBlindDCTT` is false.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Dead mobs broadcast removeBlindDCTT (-124) every update tick

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: CayThong NPC menu in maps 0, 7, 14 is broken and immediately replaced by the map 184 exit menu.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Switch cases 0, 7, 14 in CayThong.openBaseMenu are missing a break statement and fall through into case 184, overwriting the menu with 'Quay ve / Dong'.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: CayThong.openBaseMenu missing break falls through to map 184 menu

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: Players who fail the map 169 task/power check in checkMapCanJoin still lose 50M gold without entering the map.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: Whis.vaoMapHD deducts 50,000,000 gold (requiring strictly > COST_HD) before calling ChangeMapService.changeMapBySpaceShip, which later rejects entry if TaskService.getIdTask < TASK_25_0.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: Whis.vaoMapHD deducts 50M gold before map entry validation

gameplay_p0_p1_findings.impact: A player denied entry to a map (checkMapCanJoin returns null) can still have their Namek Dragon Ball dropped or tracking arrays overwritten.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.root_cause: changeMap mutates NgocRongNamecService.mapNrNamec/zoneNrNamec and calls dropNamekBall(pl) before checkMapCanJoin(pl, zoneJoin) validates whether the player can actually enter zoneJoin.
gameplay_p0_p1_findings.title: ChangeMapService mutates Namek Dragon Ball state before checkMapCanJoin validation

devops_findings.impact: Floods Unity Console with false red error badges during normal image loading and slows network message pumping to 15 Hz when window loses focus.

Main.OnApplicationFocus(false) sets `Application.targetFrameRate = 15`, throttling Update() where Session_ME.update() drains network packets.
devops_findings.title: False Debug.LogError in Image.loadData and network throttling on focus loss in Main.cs

devops_findings.root_cause: loadMapFromResource() and loadMapTableFromResource() open DataInputStream via MyStream.readFile() in loops without calling close(). Multiple paint/update methods use empty catch (Exception) blocks.
devops_findings.title: Unclosed DataInputStream in CreateCharScr and empty catch blocks

devops_findings.title: WhisArenaService.TEST_MODE_24_7 left enabled

devops_findings.title: Unclosed-socket DdosTester left in production src tree

devops_findings.impact: External URL launch or unvalidated cmd execution if invoked in production.
devops_findings.root_cause: ErrorRes.howToFix opens chatgpt.com with raw error text; FileRunner.runBatchFile passes batchFilePath directly to cmd /c start.
devops_findings.title: Dev helper ErrorRes and unvalidated ProcessBuilder in FileRunner

devops_findings.impact: Test 18 fails whenever `WhisArenaService.getRemainingMinutes()` is not 101; TestProfilerEngine pollutes real `PERFORMANCE_ALERTS.json` and `logs/metrics/` files.
devops_findings.root_cause: `TestWhisArenaLogic` asserts `expectedHeader.contains("101 phút nữa")`, and `TestProfilerEngine` writes directly to production metrics/alert paths instead of temp directories.
devops_findings.title: Brittle time-dependent assertion in TestWhisArenaLogic and side-effects in TestProfilerEngine
